reasons.readfile-command: Both handlers resolve a file path for the plugin's own vernacular commands ReadFileBytes, ReadFileInt63 and ReadFileString (g_read_file.mlg:35-74; read_file.ml:16-47). No tactic reaches them. A proveequivN agent can run these commands, so a proof whose parsed sentences from statement to closer (key item 1) contain one of them is ineligible; this is the same check as any command inside a proof (spec 'Proofs that always run'). A ReadFile command outside that span declares a constant (read_file.ml:306-314), which the global-environment read (row 1) records.
